$comment: Phase 18 acceptance definition derived from architecture/phase-18-analytics-intelligence.md, the phase contract, analytics-core/models/decisions/governance modules and their four unit suites. Analytical outputs remain derived and governed; no autonomous action or durable analytics store is inferred.

ownership.note: Phase 18 owns analytical models, metric definitions, decision records and analytics governance. Canonical records, workflow execution and cognitive architecture remain outside this phase.

areas.area: Metrics carry ownership, provenance and honest unknowns
areas.requirement: Metrics require an owner and formula, analytical outputs carry provenance and version, and missing previous or source data is not converted into zero or success.

evidence.contains: rejects a metric without an owner or formula
never treats a missing previous value as zero
requires provenance and version on every analytical output

areas.area: Analytical models have lifecycle and drift governance
areas.requirement: Models require metadata and ownership, cannot be promoted before validation, and drift is detectable against declared thresholds.

evidence.contains: detects model drift beyond the threshold

areas.area: Forecasts and anomalies state assumptions and limits
areas.requirement: Descriptive statistics do not fabricate empty samples, correlations do not claim causation, anomalies carry evidence and forecasts carry bounds and non-guarantee language.

evidence.contains: never fabricates statistics for an empty sample

areas.area: Recommendations and decisions are constrained and evidenced
areas.requirement: Unknown feasibility is infeasible, policy-violating optimization is rejected, recommendations require evidence and uncertainty, and decisions record selected options and outcomes.

evidence.contains: rejects recommendations without evidence or uncertainty

areas.area: Reporting is tenant, privacy and version governed
areas.requirement: Metric/report changes are versioned, reproducibility requires a matching snapshot and analytics access protects tenant, role, classification and small-cell privacy.

evidence.contains: versions a metric definition change instead of rewriting
requires a matching snapshot for reproducibility

areas.area: Analytics remains a tested library pending a consuming boundary
areas.requirement: A governed surface or server boundary must read analytics from real data and route actions through policy; current evidence does not prove such invocation.
